scope: Tsuchiura Otsu 2007 appearance; later close-ups support surface construction and wear placement, not wholesale adoption of later orange rust
changes: Per-shading-point assembled AO/cavity replaces broad-face interpolation of sparse vertex rays; only flipping lids keep local self-occlusion. Bake proxy supplies unique surfaces; extra high instances supply the remaining articulated tread occluders.

Paint uses millimetre-scale film pores, directional pressed texture and varied satin roughness; bare edge steel remains a separate metallic mask. Film height controls are authoring ranges, not measured coating thickness.
Cast tracks retain real chamfered edges, flange bores and hollow knuckles, pitted cast relief, directional running-face abrasion, separate oxide/dust and metallic worn metal.
Complete native-resolution high/game rebake. Existing packed pixels, authored tangents and strict actual-triangle clearance checks are validated again after export.
